summary: Formats a vehicle timing line into the caller-supplied string buffer. In a race session (dword_7C56A4 == 7) it emits the vehicle's full race time (h:mm:ss.fff) when finished, otherwise the gap to the current leader expressed as +m:ss.fff time difference, +N laps, or a resolved label string; outside a race session it emits the raw session time (m:ss.fff) or the placeholder "--:--.---" when the stored time is negative. A final status field decides whether a retirement/out label is written through the string table (returning 3) or whether the function returns 0 without producing a status label.

local_names.a1: vehicle index into the live vehicle pointer array dword_7C54F0
local_names.a2: output character buffer receiving the formatted time/gap/status string
local_names.v2: resolved vehicle pointer for index a1 (dword_7C54F0[a1])
local_names.v5: laps-completed counter read at vehicle offset 16444 for this vehicle
local_names.v7: leader vehicle pointer located by the linear scan
local_names.v8: lap difference between leader (v7) and this vehicle (offset 16444 delta)
local_names.v23: race time float read at vehicle offset 16568
local_names.v20: session time float read at vehicle offset 16540
local_names.v13: time gap to the leader (race-time difference)
local_names.byte_5EC4CC: shared buffer that receives the resolved label text used in the "+N %s" formats

operations.description: Invalid index guard: if a1 < 0 or a1 >= dword_5C329C, return 0 without writing the output string
Resolve the vehicle pointer: v2 = dword_7C54F0[a1]
Session branch: when dword_7C56A4 == 7 the race-time formatting path is taken; otherwise the session-time path
Race path setup: v4 = a2, clear *a2 to 0, read v5 = *(int*)(v2 + 16444) as the laps-completed counter
Race formatting only proceeds when v5 > 0 and the status field *(int*)(v2 + 16484) == 1
Finished/leader branch: when *(int*)(v2 + 16480) == 1 format the vehicle's own race time; otherwise compute the gap to the leader
Read the race time v23 = *(float*)(v2 + 16568) and convert it to whole hours: v21 = CRTFtol(v23 * 0.00027777778)
InterruptDispatch(v23), then convert the hour remainder to minutes: v15 = CRTFtol((v23 - v21 * 3600.0) * 0.016666668)
Format the finished race time: StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck(v4, "%d:%02.2d:%06.3f", v21, v15, v23)

Linear scan of the vehicle array dword_7C54F0[0 .. dword_5C329C) for the first vehicle whose offset-16480 field equals 1 (the leader); if the scan exhausts the array, fall through to the LABEL_27 default
When a leader pointer v7 is found, compute the lap difference v8 = *(int*)(v7 + 16444) - v5; the branch taken depends on whether v8 equals 1, is <= 0, or is greater than 1
One-lap-down case: BinarySearchInStringTable(byte_5EC4C0, &off_5C330C, byte_5EC4CC); on success copy the off_5C330C label bytes into byte_5EC4CC until the NUL terminator
Emit the one-lap label: StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck(a2, "+%d %s", 1, byte_5EC4CC)
Leader-behind-in-laps case: compute the time gap v13 = *(float*)(v2 + 16568) - *(float*)(v7 + 16568); call InterruptDispatch(v13); convert to minutes v14 = CRTFtol(v13 * 0.016666668)
Emit the time gap: StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck(v4, "+%d:%06.3f", v14, v13)

Multiple-laps-down case: BinarySearchInStringTable(byte_5EC4C0, aLaps_1, byte_5EC4CC); on success copy the aLaps_1 label into byte_5EC4CC, then StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck(a2, "+%d %s", v8, byte_5EC4CC)
LABEL_27 default for the race path: if the buffer is still empty (strlen(v4) == 0), write the placeholder via StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck(v4, "%s", "--:--.---")
Non-race session path: read the session time v20 = *(float*)(v2 + 16540)
When v20 < 0.0, write the placeholder StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck(a2, "--:--.---"); otherwise format the raw session time
Valid session time path: InterruptDispatch(v20); v3 = CRTFtol(v20 * 0.016666668); StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck(a2, "%d:%06.3f", v3, v20)
Read the final status field v16 = *(int*)(v2 + 16484)
Status gate: if v16 != 3 and (dword_7C56A4 != 7 or v16 != 2), return 0; otherwise a status label is emitted

Status 3 (retired) case: v17 = off_5C3298; if BinarySearchInStringTable(byte_5EC4C0, off_5C3298, byte_5EC4CC) succeeds, copy v17 (or clear the buffer when null) into byte_5EC4CC; then strcpy(v4, byte_5EC4CC) and return 3

Status 2 in a race session: resolve the failure category v19 = FailureCategoryNameLookup(*(int*)(v2 + 16488)); on a successful string-table lookup copy it (or clear when null) into byte_5EC4CC; then strcpy(v4, byte_5EC4CC) and return 3
Function returns 0 when the vehicle index is out of range or the status gate is not satisfied, and 3 once a retirement/out status label has been emitted into the buffer
